items.title: How Investors May Respond To ICE Wind Futures Launch
items.summary: Intercontinental Exchange announced plans to list 15 cash settled wind futures tied to ENWEX indices for seven major European wind markets. These will cover onshore, offshore and combined output, with a launch date previously set for December 14, 2026, subject to regulatory approvals. The contracts aim to make weather driven wind generation risk tradable across more than 70% of Europe’s installed wind capacity. items.title: Why Is Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Backing A Prediction Market Platform Now?
items.summary: Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE: ICE) has taken a major equity stake in prediction market platform Polymarket as the firm prepares for a 2027 IPO. Polymarket is undergoing significant restructuring, including leadership changes and high profile hires, alongside its push toward public market readiness.
